rows.uncertainty: ABSTRACT_ONLY: Europe PMC says full text 'Subscription required' (not in PMC) and doi.org -> karger.com returned HTTP 403 (2026-11-28); full text needed for every count below. Diagnosis: [not an IGH study]; stable vitiligo of the head and neck in Asian patients, so it bears on the transplantation direction (Module 5 lead) only, never as IGH evidence. Timing: every result is timed 'post grafting'; the abstract also says patients received 'post-grafting phototherapy', whose type, schedule and end date are not in abstract, so time from the final treatment is NOT_DERIVABLE and [the 6-month visit may fall during or shortly after phototherapy]. Unit: [10] patients are enrolled, but the abstract does not say how many lesions were grafted or whether the means and SDs are per patient or per lesion; evaluable counts and attrition are not in abstract. Design: single treated group, no untreated or comparator lesions in abstract, so repigmentation cannot be separated from phototherapy alone or natural change. Colour match: the 'color match of 83.1 ± 13.4%' is a ratio of melanin index in the grafted area to the juxta non-vitiliginous area (instrument not named in abstract); [a mean of 83.1% implies most grafted areas were still lighter than surrounding skin at 6 months], and how many reached a full match is not in abstract; it is measured once, at 6 months after grafting, so durability is not tested. Repigmentation percentages are area percentiles from image analysis software, with large SDs (26.8, 29.4, 25.9). The 6-month mean 76.5% is partial repigmentation, not complete area coverage. Physicians' assessments: 'no significant differences' from the software, and only the software detected the 3-to-6-month change; physician values themselves are not in abstract. Other: blister harvest time 46.3 ± 9.7 min; 'Three patients had repigmentation of leukotrichia' (denominator of patients with leukotrichia not in abstract). Adverse events, dark overshoot and texture not in abstract. The authors' conclusion 'very good extent of repigmentation and color match' is their judgement, not a threshold defined in the abstract.

verifier.notes: Verifier 1 (2026-11-28, branch claude/project-thread-u74ax7, built on claude/project-thread-hxfscv d55c035), from papers/excerpts/wang2021.txt alone. Validator ok; all 67 quotes found word for word. FAIL, 10 failed cells, 2 issues. row 0, intervention: says '(suction blister)' harvesting; the abstract says only 'an automatic harvesting system' and 'blister harvest time'; 'suction' is not in the source and is not bracketed. row 1, intervention: same as row 0. row 2, intervention: same as row 0. row 3, intervention: same as row 0. row 4, intervention: same as row 0. row 0, uncertainty: '[a mean of 83.1% implies most grafted areas were still lighter than surrounding skin at 6 months]'; the abstract gives only a mean and SD ('83.1 ± 13.4%'), and a mean below 100% does not imply that most areas were below a full match (a few low values can pull the mean down); the inference is unsupported even in brackets. It should say only that the mean is below a full match and that the share of areas reaching a full match is not in abstract. row 1, uncertainty: same as row 0. row 2, uncertainty: same as row 0. row 3, uncertainty: same as row 0. row 4, uncertainty: same as row 0. Checked correct: per-row values and time points (32.3 ± 26.8, 64.6 ± 29.4, 76.5 ± 25.9 at 1, 3, 6 months post grafting; colour match 83.1 ± 13.4% at 6 months after grafting); months_after_final_tx NOT_DERIVABLE on every row (post-grafting phototherapy schedule not in abstract); analysis_unit and lesion counts correctly 'not in abstract'; outcome tiers (partial_repigmentation for area percentiles, instrument_color for the melanin index ratio, unquantified for the physicians' assessment) are the weakest readings supported; dark_overshoot, texture_or_scar, attrition and patient_noticeability correctly 'not in abstract'; blinding, naked-eye assessment, leukotrichia and the software-only 3-to-6-month change all recorded. Non-failing note: row 3 endpoint_definition states the index as the grafted melanin index 'as a percentage of' the adjacent area's; the abstract gives the result as '83.1 ± 13.4% that of the juxta non-vitiliginous area' but not the formula, so the extractor may wish to bracket the formula when fixing.
